```yaml
name: PR Preview Docs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: pr-preview-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy-pr-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Build docs
        run: |
          mike deploy --push --update-aliases pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --config-file mkdocs.yml

      - name: Get changed docs URLs
        id: changed-docs
        run: |
          python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py > changed_docs_urls.txt || true
          echo "CHANGED_DOCS_URLS=$(cat changed_docs_urls.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post PR comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: pr-preview
          message: |
            📄 **Documentation Preview**
            
            Preview URL: https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/
            
            ${{ steps.changed-docs.outputs.CHANGED_DOCS_URLS && format('**Changed Pages:**\n{0}', steps.changed-docs.outputs.CHANGED_DOCS_URLS) || 'No changed documentation pages detected.' }}

  cleanup-pr-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.action == 'closed'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mike

      - name: Remove PR preview
        run: |
          mike delete pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --push --config-file mkdocs.yml

      - name: Remove PR comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: pr-preview
          delete: true
```
